entries.content:
At Mountain State Spotlight, we always want to learn about our readers and how we can better serve all West Virginians.

That’s why we’re launching a reader survey asking about your news habits, a bit about who you are, and why you choose to read us. 

By completing this survey, you will help us better understand who you are so that we can provide more reporting that focuses on the news and information you want and need to make your community and our state better places for all of us to live. 

Take the survey

As a token of gratitude for taking time out of your day, anyone who takes the survey by Friday, Sept. 4 will be entered into a giveaway for a $25 credit to J.Q. Dickinson Appalachian Mercantile.
